assessment.title: Assessment
assessment.tagline: Informed Decisions for a Sustainable Future
assessment.intro: Understand the Environmental Reality Before You Build. Sound environmental decisions begin with reliable assessment. ERCPL conducts scientific assessments to understand baseline conditions, environmental risks, potential impacts and regulatory requirements before and during project development.

items.title: Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA)
items.text: Detailed assessment of potential environmental impacts to support project planning and statutory approvals.

items.title: Site & Baseline Assessment
items.text: Assessment of environmental conditions and project-specific risks.

items.title: Water Audits
items.text: Assessment of water consumption, management and conservation opportunities.

items.title: Hydrological Studies
items.text: Technical studies supporting water-resource planning and regulatory requirements.

items.title: Air Quality Modelling
items.text: Predictive assessment of air-quality impacts for environmental planning and submissions.

items.title: Noise Modelling
items.text: Assessment and modelling of potential noise impacts.

items.title: Land Use / Land Cover Analysis
items.text: Geospatial analysis for project planning, land management and environmental assessment.

items.title: Environmental & Ecological Studies
items.text: Assessment of environmental conditions, ecosystems and resource requirements.

items.title: Drone Survey & DGPS Survey
items.text: High-precision mapping for accurate data and better decisions.

items.title: Planning & Design
items.text: Translate insights into practical, sustainable solutions.

clearances.title: Clearances
clearances.intro: Clear the Regulatory Path for Your Project. Environmental approvals can be complex, documentation-heavy and time-sensitive. ERC provides structured technical and regulatory support to help project proponents understand requirements, prepare documentation and navigate applicable statutory approval processes.

process.title: Prepare
process.text: Compile studies, reports and required documents as per regulatory norms.

process.title: Apply
process.text: Submission to relevant authorities with complete information.

process.title: Evaluation
process.text: Review, site inspections and addressing queries from authorities.

process.title: Approval
process.text: Grant of clearances / NOCs with prescribed conditions.

process.title: Comply & Sustain
process.text: Adhere to conditions and maintain ongoing compliance.

items.title: Environmental Clearance (EC)
items.text: Technical assistance for obtaining statutory Environmental Clearance.

items.title: Consent to Establish (CTE)
items.text: Support for regulatory permissions required before establishing eligible projects.

items.title: Consent to Operate (CTO)
items.text: Compliance support for operational permissions.

items.title: CGWA / CGWB NOCs
items.text: Support for groundwater-related approvals and documentation.

items.title: Forest Clearance
items.text: Assistance with applicable forest-related permissions.

items.title: Wildlife Clearance
items.text: Support for wildlife-related statutory approvals.

items.title: Fire NOC
items.text: Assistance with fire-related statutory requirements.

items.title: WRD NOC
items.text: Support for applicable Water Resources Department permissions.

items.title: AAI Height Clearance
items.text: Support for height-clearance requirements for applicable developments.

items.title: Mining Plans & Mine Closure Plans
items.text: Technical planning for mining operations and environmentally responsible closure.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.intro: Measure What Matters. Environmental compliance depends on reliable data. ERCPL provides structured environmental monitoring services covering air, water, soil and noise, helping organisations establish baseline conditions, monitor environmental performance and support statutory compliance.

items.title: Air Quality Monitoring
items.text: Measurement and assessment of relevant ambient air parameters.

items.title: Noise Monitoring
items.text: Monitoring of environmental noise to support compliance and impact assessment.

items.title: Water Quality Monitoring
items.text: Sampling and testing of applicable surface water, groundwater and other water sources.

items.title: Field Sampling
items.text: Systematic site-based sampling using standardised procedures.

items.title: Soil Monitoring
items.text: Soil sampling and environmental quality assessment.

items.title: Laboratory Testing
items.text: Testing through associated NABL-accredited and MoEF&CC-approved laboratory facilities.

items.title: Data Analysis & Reporting
items.text: Conversion of monitoring data into technical reports and actionable recommendations.

audit_compliance.title: Audit & Compliance
audit_compliance.intro: Compliance Is Not a One-Time Event. Modern organisations are expected to do more than comply with regulations. They must manage resources responsibly, improve environmental performance, protect workplace safety and build long-term resilience. ERCPL helps organisations integrate environmental thinking into planning, operations and development.

cycle.title: Environmental Audits
cycle.text: Evaluate environmental performance, identify gaps and recommend improvements.

cycle.title: Compliance Support
cycle.text: Guidance on applicable regulations, documentation and preparation for inspections.

cycle.title: Post-Clearance Compliances
cycle.text: Ongoing support to meet conditions of clearances and statutory requirements.

cycle.title: Monitoring & Reporting
cycle.text: Track performance, maintain records and submit compliance reports.

cycle.title: Sustainable Operations
cycle.text: Reduced risk, regulatory confidence and a cleaner, greener tomorrow.

items.title: Sustainable Development Planning
items.text: Integrate environmental considerations into project and business decisions.

items.title: Resource Conservation
items.text: Identify opportunities to improve responsible use of water and natural resources.

items.title: Environmental Management
items.text: Develop practical approaches to managing environmental impacts and resources.

items.title: Sustainable Architecture
items.text: Support environmentally responsible site planning, building design and interiors.

items.title: EHS Support
items.text: Strengthen environmental health and workplace safety practices.

items.title: Green Building Support
items.text: Integrate energy-efficient and eco-friendly design principles where applicable.

items.title: Sustainability Analysis
items.text: Evaluate project and organisational practices from an environmental and sustainability perspective.
